en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a ceremonial military inspection or drill. Two ranks of uniformed soldiers face each other, wearing ornate dress uniforms with tall boots, sashes, and distinctive czapka-style square-topped caps. A commanding officer stands in the center with his back to the camera, holding a sword. Some soldiers hold rifles with bayonets; a bugler stands on the left. In the background are barracks-like buildings and a striped guard box, suggesting a formal parade ground.
